title: The effect of thyroid hormone therapy on muscle function, strength and mass in older adults with subclinical hypothyroidism-an ancillary study within two randomized placebo controlled trials
authors: Netzer S, Chocano-Bedoya P, Feller M, Janett-Pellegri C, Wildisen L, Büchi AE, et al.
population: Swiss and Dutch participants of TRUST and IEMO 80-plus aged 65 or older with TSH 4.60 to 19.99 mIU/l and normal free T4; mean age 77.5 years, 48.3% women
funder: Funding statement not read: the publisher's full text returned HTTP 403 to automated access and repository copies were restricted.
result: At the final visit mean TSH was 3.8 mIU/l on levothyroxine and 5.1 on placebo. Gait speed did not differ (adjusted mean difference 0.01 m/s, 95% CI -0.06 to 0.09), nor handgrip strength at 1 year (-1.22 kg, -2.60 to 0.15) or yearly change in muscle mass (-0.15 m2, -0.49 to 0.18). Results read from the PubMed abstract.
